title: On the information rate of phones, syllables and words
abstract: arXiv:2611.13990v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Which linguistic units minimise the bitrate required to encode speech content: phones, syllables, words, maybe larger units, or something in between? This question has implications for the development of speech and language systems and theories of human language processing. Using a transcribed corpus of 960 hours of English audiobooks, I compare the information rates of phones, syllables, words, multi-word combinations and intermediate tokenisations. While all units are equivalent under a perfect language model, it makes sense to compare these under limited modelling budgets; I use $n$-gram and transformer language models. The lowest bitrates are achieved using words, with slightly longer units sometimes performing best. The results show that, when modelling capacity is limited, units larger than syllables but smaller than long multi-word phrases provide the most efficient representation in terms of information rate.

translated_title: 关于音素、音节和词汇的信息速率
translated_abstract: 哪种语言单位能最小化编码语音内容所需的比特率：是音素、音节、词汇，也许是更大的单位，还是介于两者之间的某种单位？这个问题对语音和语言系统的开发以及人类语言处理理论具有重要意义。本文使用960小时英语有声读物的转录语料库，比较了音素、音节、词汇、多词组合以及中间分词方式的信息速率。虽然在完美语言模型下所有单位都是等效的，但在有限的建模预算下比较这些单位是有意义的；作者使用了n-gram和transformer语言模型。结果表明，使用词汇时达到了最低的比特率，稍长的单位有时表现最佳。研究显示，当建模能力受限时，比音节大但小于长多词短语的单位在信息速率方面提供了最高效的表示。
tldr: 该研究利用960小时英语有声读物语料库，在n-gram和transformer语言模型的有限建模预算下比较不同语言单位的信息速率，发现词汇（及稍长的单位）能实现最低比特率，表明比音节大但小于长多词短语的语言单位是编码语音内容最高效的表示方式。
